name: C0 continuity
domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 场函数值在单元连接处连续而不要求其一阶导数连续的性质。
usage_note: 该文用于轨道板层次插值函数的连续性要求。
usage_overview: 在轨道板的层次插值建模中，用于规定面内位移及独立转角等变量的连续性要求，使其在单元连接处函数值连续，而不要求一阶导数连续。

complete_examples.text: In this section, the hierarchical function with C0 continuity and C1 continuity is introduced to discretize the displacement of the track structure.
The subscript k represents denote the order of the hierarchical function, which should satisfy the condition n ≥2 to satisfy the C0 continuity.
